explanation: This tests variation of parameters for a linear differential-equation system, which is not among the supplied course topics and is classified as prerequisite. Write the particular solution as (30t-26,q(t))^T/9. The first equation gives 30=-3(30t-26)+2q(t)+18t, so q(t)=36t-24. The second equation also holds: 36=-6(30t-26)+5(36t-24).
